entities.summary: Dagobert I, a notable figure in the history of Czechia, associated with Celtic, Germanic & Early Slavic Bohemia (500–800). Preceded by Slavic Settlement & Samo's Empire and Boii & Germanic Period. Their legacy influenced Samo's Empire — first Slavic political entity and Mission of Saints Cyril and Methodius to Great Moravia.
